title: FinTech Startups Innovate Faster with Ecosystem Access
primary_theme: Fast-moving FinTech startups need early ecosystem connectivity
founder_lessons: Move quickly and be precise about the specific financial services problem you are solving.
Use investors who can unblock bank, insurance, payments, and partner relationships.
Let founder energy and market insight guide the opportunity rather than chasing a preset theme list.
Keep the business lean and receptive to market terms when fundraising conditions are choppy.
notable_quotes: Ideally, we wanna be that first institutional partner.
Our model is to optimize for speed.
In FinTech, there are some interesting, non-profits who operate in this space that do really interesting work.
